verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms Ollama serves a valid llms.txt file at the standard location (HTTP 200) with a description of the product, directly satisfying the story of pointing an agent at agent-oriented docs; this is corroborated by extensive agent-oriented documentation (Claude Code, Codex, OpenAI/Anthropic API compatibility, `ollama launch`) suggesting agent-first docs strategy. Missing for 10: no independent/community confirmation that an agent has actually consumed llms.txt successfully, and alternate agent-doc formats (docs.md, openapi.json) return 404, showing coverage is not comprehensive across all agent-doc conventions.
